title: WCLI-186 follow-ups: three test and runbook cleanups from the #422 review

finalSummary: Landed in opum-ai/ward-cli#423 (origin/dev e4ab41d): the stale unset comment fixed, one TRACE_SCAN const shared by the assertions and their positive controls (the helper scan gains the -o xtrace branch), and the set-key-partition-list runbook note moved to a failure-signature bullet.
